explicitLimits: BSC: contiguous receipts. Base live cursor is separate from unresolved historic base cursor; historical gap NOT COVERED. Observed transfers are NOT exchange net inventory or confirmed independent wallets. LP actions are NOT necessarily bullish. Unscanned blocks and failed RPC are NOT zero events. Priority liveTip only observes its own window; missingMiddleRange is never coverage.

lpNet.caveat: Net per owner+tick range is within this scanned window only. A zero net round-trip can be transient/JIT liquidity; NOT evidence of persistent LP removal or pre-pump accumulation.
